name: Eton
why: The Swedish dress-shirt specialist since 1928 — the Incotex principle applied to shirts; the quality anchor of every department-store shirt wall.
origin: Annie and David Pettersson, Gånghester, Sweden, 1928 — a tailoring workshop turned shirt house; renamed for Eton after the war, exporting Swedish precision ever since.
opview: One garment, perfected — the house line on why it makes only shirts.

notes.cotton: signature twills and poplins — the shirt wall's benchmark
notes.finbro: the banker's shirt — non-iron done at quality

cities: Dept & specialty nationwide · one own shop
